author: MegaBuilds
description:
The world’s biggest mining project just came online. It’s deep in the jungles of Guinea, but it’s at the center of an international power play with China. It took nearly 30 years of politics and scandal, more than 600 kilometers of railway, and a deepwater port built from scratch.

In this video, we'll look at Simandou:  A new gigantic mine carved into the beautiful Guinea highlands. One that reshapes the global steel market.
